title: Surveillance Study - Incidence of Antibiotic Resistance in Serial Gram-negative Bloodstream Isolates
brief_summary: This research is important because it allows for the determination of resistance rates to antibiotics that may not be frequently tested by the clinical microbiology laboratory at University of Pittsburgh Medical Center (UPMC)-Presbyterian. It also will provide antibiotic minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs) for these pathogens which may help in identifying the best empiric antibiotic option for gram-negative blood stream infections based on known pharmacodynamic parameters.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with positive gram-negative bacteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 18 years of age
